strength.label: Removable Powerpacks
strength.text: FONZ advertises two removable Powerpacks, 11 kg each, that can be charged off the scooter.

tradeoff.label: Delivery costs extra
tradeoff.text: The advertised amount excludes local dealer delivery and freight; its stated on-road inclusions apply at Sydney HQ.

conditions: Source-qualified advertised offer with an incomplete factory build. MY26 is supplier-stated offer identity, not VIN certification or production-effectivity proof.
This is a 10% reservation offer, not a full purchase or verified physical stock. No allocated VIN, accepted order or checkout amount has been verified.

Eco up to 130 km, Street around 104 km and Max Performance around 72 km are FONZ claims: 80 kg reference load, about 25°C and new Powerpacks; no named standard cycle, fixed road-speed schedule or independently tested real-world range.
Two removable Powerpacks are advertised at 11 kg each. The exact shipped charger SKU/count and inclusion remain unverified; Type 2 is optional.
